dedupe_keys.name: grficsv3 containerised ot ics security lab simulating a chemical plant

description: GRFICS (Graphical Realism Framework for Industrial Control Simulation) is an open-source operational technology security lab that simulates an industrial chemical plant together with its control system and an attacker's toolkit. Version 3 is published by Fortiphyd Logic, building on the original academic GRFICS framework. Coverage: one generic chemical process plant, not a real site. The lab couples a process simulation with realistic dynamics to programmable logic controllers, a human-machine interface, an engineering workstation, routers and a firewall with Suricata intrusion detection, segmented process and enterprise networks, 3D visualisation of tanks and valves with a first-person walkthrough, and attacker tools such as Kali Linux and MITRE Caldera, with an optional Wazuh SIEM. Format and access: Docker Compose deployment from a public GitHub repository; free. Licence: GNU GPL 3.0. Caveats: it is a training and research lab with one process model, not a validated plant simulator, and attack traffic generated in it reflects the lab set-up. Simulation uses: cyber-physical cascading failure and emergency response exercises, testing detection tools and generating labelled industrial control traffic for resilience studies. Related records: ICS-SimLab (model-ics-simlab-containerised-ics-simulation) and ICSSIM (model-icssim-ics-security-testbed-framework) are comparable containerised control system testbeds.
